notes: Robotics/physical-AI has no child: failed robot demos vs Physical AI research. YOLO how-tos vs architecture/benchmarks split Education vs Frontier Models. Coding agents sit on Developer Tools vs AI Agents (agents exclude coding harnesses). Thin timed clips (song, emoji, it's-alive) need x_thread summary_hint. Long interviews span shelves; primary is the central excerpt subject. Clickbait titles ignored when excerpts are lectures.
